item.description: S.C. House Republicans voted on Thursday to rename three state roads in honor of President Donald Trump and slain conservative activist Charlie Kirk over the objections of many of the chamber’s longest-serving Democrats. item.title: South Carolina’s tax paradox: High rates, low bills
item.description: For the second time in a year, S.C. lawmakers were caught flat-footed this week by public backlash over the consequences of their still-evolving plan to cut the state’s top income tax rate. item.title: City Paper wins 31 awards at state press contest
item.description: The Charleston City Paper on March 6 won more awards for South Carolina newspaper excellence than any other weekly newspaper in the state. It brought home a cache of seven first places, eight second places and 16 third place awards in the annual S.C. Press Association contest for news and design excellence. The post City Paper wins 31 awards at state press contest appeared first on Charleston City Paper.
